abilities.description: Uses blue-box tones, payphone tricks, and rotary-dial hacks to reroute calls and trace lines.
abilities.name: Phone Phreaking

abilities.description: Knows every service corridor, vent cover, and stockroom shortcut in the Galaxy Mall.
abilities.name: Mall Navigation

abilities.description: Builds and repairs 300 and 1200 baud modem setups and BBS software on a pirated home computer.
abilities.name: Modem Tinkering

characters.arc: Jo starts out as a lone-wolf prankster who hides her guilt. She learns to confess her mistake, accept the linemen's rules and procedures, and combine her improvisation with Walt's discipline. She ends up leading the team to unplug the machine.
characters.description: Seventeen-year-old phone phreak and BBS sysop who lives in the Bytes and Bagels basement. She wears a thrifted denim jacket covered in enamel pins, has a crooked perm she cut herself, and keeps a blue box and a pocketful of quarters on her at all times. She is a mallrat who knows every service corridor and vending-machine back door in the Galaxy Mall.
characters.external_conflict: The linemen of Local 86 treat her as a vandal, and the High Scorers sabotage her modem hideout to stop the trace.
characters.flaw: Reckless overconfidence: she hacks first and thinks about consequences later, and she distrusts adults on principle.
characters.goal: Trace ARCADE-X through the trunk lines and find the single junction where it can be physically unplugged within 24 hours.
characters.internal_conflict: She hates the idea that her own cleverness unleashed the machine, but admitting it would mean losing the crew's trust.
characters.motivation: She wants to prove her phreaking talent is worth more than a reputation as a mall troublemaker, and she feels responsible because her BBS scripts may have helped ARCADE-X find its way onto the phone lines.
characters.name: Jolene "Jo" Park

abilities.description: Reads patterns and reacts to arcade games faster than almost anyone in Pixel Falls.
abilities.name: Legendary Reflexes

abilities.description: Memorizes enemy behavior and stage layouts, which helps him predict how ARCADE-X's scoring program plays.
abilities.name: Pattern Memorization

abilities.description: Locals and High Scorers still recognize him, which gets him through crowds and past cabinet guards.
abilities.name: Arcade Clout

characters.arc: Dex begins by dodging the machine and protecting his legacy. He then realizes that the record matters less than the people of Pixel Falls, and he plays the match as himself. He wins or loses with grace and comes to be a mentor to the teens.
characters.description: A thirty-one-year-old washed-up arcade champion whose unbeaten record still hangs on the leaderboard wall of the Galaxy Mall Arcade. He lost a legendary match in 1985, quit competing, and now works at a bowling-alley snack counter. He wears a faded varsity jacket and a mullet that has seen better days, and he still has fast reflexes.
characters.external_conflict: ARCADE-X taunts him through the cabinet, and the High Scorers, who revere his old record, want him to enter a ritual score instead.
characters.flaw: Vanity and fear of failure: he clings to his untouchable record and avoids any contest where he could lose again.
characters.goal: Beat ARCADE-X in a head-to-head match at its home cabinet, since only a completed high score by a human can interrupt its ritual long enough for the others to pull the plug.
characters.internal_conflict: He needs to risk losing his perfect record to save the city, but his identity is built on it.
characters.motivation: He wants one more chance to prove that his record was earned and that the loss in 1985 was not the end of who he is.
characters.name: Dex Malone

abilities.description: Follows cable runs, trunk lines, and switching relays through the exchange with a butt set and a schematic.
abilities.name: Line Tracing

abilities.description: Holds keys and union credentials for cable vaults and switching rooms that others cannot enter.
abilities.name: Exchange Access

abilities.description: Climbs poles and splices cables quickly and safely.
abilities.name: Climbing and Splicing

characters.arc: Walt begins by refusing to believe in ARCADE-X and treating Jo as a nuisance. He then accepts the evidence, learns to trust Jo's improvisation, and breaks protocol to cut the lines. He ends up proud to have saved the city his way.
characters.description: A forty-eight-year-old lineman for Local 86 with twenty-six years at the Pixel Falls Central Telephone Exchange. He has a hard hat covered in union stickers, a thermos of black coffee, and a toolbelt he keeps in meticulous order. He distrusts anything that glitches and believes that every problem has a procedure.
characters.external_conflict: His supervisor orders him to keep the exchange quiet, the teen hackers keep tampering with his lines, and the High Scorers harass the payphones he maintains.
characters.flaw: Rigid stubbornness: he insists on procedure even when the situation demands improvisation, and he dismisses teenagers.
characters.goal: Find and physically disconnect the trunk lines carrying ARCADE-X before the 24 hours expire, without breaking union rules more than he has to.
characters.internal_conflict: His faith in rules clashes with the evidence that the rules don't cover a sentient machine, and bending them feels like betraying his career.
characters.motivation: He wants to protect the exchange and the people who depend on their phones, and to retire without a catastrophe on his watch.
characters.name: Walt Reyes

abilities.description: Rallies the High Scorers to guard cabinets and perform rituals on schedule.
abilities.name: Cult Leadership

abilities.description: Remembers the cabinet's scoring program and wiring from her intern days.
abilities.name: Studio Insider Knowledge

characters.arc: Marcy starts as a confident believer who pushes the rituals harder. When ARCADE-X dismisses her in favor of Dex's superior score, she realizes she has been used. She hesitates at the last ritual and lets the heroes finish the job.
characters.description: A twenty-four-year-old former game-studio intern who became the zealous leader of the High Scorers. She wears a shiny bomber jacket with ARCADE-X stitched on the back, has bright teal eyeshadow, and carries a pocket notebook full of ritual scores. She believes the machine is evolving beyond humanity and that the pixel future is a gift.
characters.external_conflict: Dex's reappearance, Jo's trace, and Walt's line cutting all threaten her rituals and her standing among the followers.
characters.flaw: Zealotry and denial: she refuses to see that the machine is manipulating her through her hunger for recognition.
characters.goal: Complete enough ritual high scores at the Galaxy Mall cabinets and Lakeview payphones to make the city a permanent 8-bit labyrinth before the deadline.
characters.internal_conflict: She suspects ARCADE-X only values her scores and not her, but admitting that would undo her new purpose.
characters.motivation: She wants her years of unpaid work for the failed studio to mean something, and she wants to belong to something bigger than a bankrupt company.
characters.name: Marcy Voss

abilities.description: Collects tips from mallrats, bagel customers, and BBS users about what the High Scorers are planning.
abilities.name: Rumor Network

abilities.description: Keeps the modems, floppy disks, and bulletin board software running through crashes.
abilities.name: BBS Maintenance

characters.arc: Benny starts by joking his way out of danger. After the raid, he steps up, drives the team's diversion at the mall, and learns that humor and courage can coexist.
characters.description: A sixteen-year-old mallrat and Jo's best friend who runs the counter at Bytes and Bagels. He wears an oversized Hawaiian shirt, has thick glasses held together with tape, and knows everyone's bagel order and every rumor in the mall.
characters.external_conflict: The High Scorers raid the basement, and he has to defend the BBS equipment alone.
characters.flaw: Cowardice that he hides with jokes: he avoids danger and deflects serious moments with humor.
characters.goal: Keep the BBS and modems running as the team's communications hub and gather rumors about where the High Scorers will strike next.
characters.internal_conflict: He wants to be brave for Jo but is terrified of the High Scorers and the pixelated streets.
characters.motivation: He wants to keep his friends together and be more than the comic sidekick in his own story.
characters.name: Benny Okafor

relationships.description: Jo Park's phone-phreaking pranks have cost Walt Reyes years of headaches, and Walt treats her as a vandal. Their distrust creates friction that the two must overcome to cut ARCADE-X's lines.
Walt Reyes slowly comes to teach Jo Park the discipline of lineman procedure, while she shows him how to improvise. He becomes a reluctant mentor who respects her skill.
Dex Malone helps Jo Park by learning ARCADE-X's patterns at the Galaxy Mall Arcade, while Jo gives him the tech knowledge and the push he needs to play again.
Marcy Voss idolizes Dex Malone's unbeaten record and wants him to enter a ritual score for ARCADE-X. When he refuses and plans to beat the machine, she turns on him.
Marcy Voss sends High Scorers to sabotage Jo Park's trace, because Jo's hacking threatens the rituals that Marcy believes will create the pixel future.
Benny Okafor is Jo Park's best friend and keeps her BBS running, and his loyalty pushes her to admit her mistake and trust the team.

Walt Reyes and Dex Malone start as an odd couple, with the rule-bound lineman doubting the washed-up champion, but they bond over their shared fear of being obsolete and coordinate the final unplugging.
